title: Terms availability and product information
description: Read the current terms availability notice for Vector OS and check product-account, commercial and beta release information.
html:
Product information

Terms availability

Current billing and access information.

Final customer policy pending
This information preserves current boundaries and does not stand in for approved commercial terms or an effective customer privacy notice.

Current access

Discovery entries and historical demonstrations do not grant a connector, licence, installer or engineering certification.

Monthly subscriptions

Stripe checkout identifies the merchant as Infrastructure Intelligence and shows the selected USD monthly price before payment. Subscriptions renew monthly until canceled. Contact office@sh3ikhmabz.com using your checkout email for activation, cancellation or billing support.

Account access

Payment does not automatically create a Vector OS account or grant application credits. Account sign-in and automatic access activation are coming later.

Commercial terms

Full commercial terms and the refund policy are still being finalized. Contact support before subscribing if you need clarification.

Engineering responsibility

Application licences and exact compatibility are separate requirements. Demonstrations are not approved construction designs or native product acceptance.
